2A Lost and found — past simple, holidays
2B On top of the world — past continuous, at/in/on, weak forms
2C A story to remember — sequencers, connectors, verb phrases, stress
3A The waiting game — be going to, airports, letter g
3B Can we meet? — future arrangements, verb + preposition
3C Word games — defining relative clauses, paraphrasing, silent e

questions.question: Choose the correct question about Ali's home.

explanation.en: Use question word + auxiliary + subject + base verb.
explanation.ru: Используйте: вопросительное слово + вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее + глагол в начальной форме.
explanation.kk: Сұрау сөз + көмекші етістік + бастауыш + етістіктің негізгі формасы қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: What ___ your first name?

explanation.en: The singular subject your first name takes is.
explanation.ru: Единственное число: подлежащее your first name требует формы is.
explanation.kk: Жекеше бастауыш your first name is формасын талап етеді.

questions.question: Choose the correct question about Sara's job.

explanation.en: Use does before the singular subject and do as the main verb.
explanation.ru: Does ставится перед подлежащим в единственном числе, а do — смысловой глагол.
explanation.kk: Does жекеше бастауыштың алдына қойылады, ал do — негізгі етістік.

questions.question: Complete: ___ brothers have you got?

explanation.en: Brothers is a plural countable noun.
explanation.ru: Brothers — исчисляемое существительное во множественном числе.
explanation.kk: Brothers — көпше түрдегі саналатын зат есім.

questions.question: Choose the question that asks about a class start time.

explanation.en: What time asks for a clock time.
explanation.ru: What time спрашивает о времени по часам.
explanation.kk: What time сағат бойынша уақытты сұрайды.

options.text: Why do you like the class?
What time does the class start?

questions.question: Choose the correct subject question.

explanation.en: Who as the subject does not need does in this question.
explanation.ru: Who в роли подлежащего не требует does в этом вопросе.
explanation.kk: Who бастауыш болған кезде бұл сұрақта does қажет емес.

questions.question: Put the words into a standard yes/no question: can / you / spell / it.

explanation.en: A standard modal question puts can before the subject.
explanation.ru: В обычном вопросе с модальным глаголом can ставится перед подлежащим.
explanation.kk: Модальды етістігі бар қарапайым сұрақта can бастауыштың алдына қойылады.

questions.question: Complete: ___ you like studying in the library?

explanation.en: Use do to ask about a present simple action with you.
explanation.ru: Do используется для вопроса о действии в present simple с you.
explanation.kk: Do you-мен present simple-дағы іс-әрекет туралы сұрау үшін қолданылады.

questions.question: Which question asks about frequency?

explanation.en: How often asks about frequency.
explanation.ru: How often спрашивает о частоте.
explanation.kk: How often жиілікті сұрайды.

questions.question: Complete: ___ notebook is this? — It is Dana's.

explanation.en: Whose asks about possession.
explanation.ru: Whose спрашивает о принадлежности.
explanation.kk: Whose тиесілілікті сұрайды.

questions.question: Complete: ___ is this dictionary? — Twelve pounds.

explanation.en: How much asks about price.
explanation.ru: How much спрашивает о цене.
explanation.kk: How much бағаны сұрайды.

questions.question: Complete: How ___ are you? — I am nineteen.

explanation.en: How old asks about age.
explanation.ru: How old спрашивает о возрасте.
explanation.kk: How old жасты сұрайды.

questions.question: Choose the correct request when you do not know the letters in a name.

explanation.en: Spell asks for the letters of a word.
explanation.ru: Spell просит назвать буквы слова.
explanation.kk: Spell сөздің әріптерін атауды сұрайды.

options.text: How do you spell your surname?
When do you wear your surname?

questions.question: Complete the common phrase: ___ up at seven in the morning.

explanation.en: Get up means leave your bed after sleeping.
explanation.ru: Get up значит вставать с постели после сна.
explanation.kk: Get up — ұйқыдан кейін төсектен тұру дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete the phrase: go ___ bed.

explanation.en: The fixed phrase is go to bed.
explanation.ru: Устойчивое выражение — go to bed.
explanation.kk: Тұрақты тіркес — go to bed.

questions.question: Complete: I usually ___ my homework after dinner.

explanation.en: The usual collocation is do homework.
explanation.ru: Обычное сочетание — do homework.
explanation.kk: Жиі қолданылатын тіркес — do homework.

questions.question: Complete: We ___ breakfast at eight.

explanation.en: Have breakfast means eat the morning meal.
explanation.ru: Have breakfast значит поесть утром.
explanation.kk: Have breakfast — таңертең тамақтану дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: Can you ___ a photo of us?

explanation.en: The collocation is take a photo.
explanation.ru: Сочетание — take a photo.
explanation.kk: Тіркес — take a photo.

questions.question: Complete: I listen ___ music on the bus.

explanation.en: Listen is followed by to before the object.
explanation.ru: После listen перед дополнением ставится to.
explanation.kk: Listen етістігінен кейін толықтауыштың алдында to қойылады.

questions.question: Complete: My sister works ___ a nurse.

explanation.en: Work as introduces a person's job.
explanation.ru: Work as вводит профессию человека.
explanation.kk: Work as адамның мамандығын білдіреді.

questions.question: Which letter name is pronounced /eɪ/ in English?

explanation.en: The letter A is pronounced /eɪ/.
explanation.ru: Буква A произносится /eɪ/.
explanation.kk: A әрпі /eɪ/ деп айтылады.

questions.question: Which letter name is pronounced /juː/ in English?

explanation.en: The letter U has the name /juː/.
explanation.ru: Название буквы U — /juː/.
explanation.kk: U әрпінің аталуы — /juː/.

questions.question: Choose the appropriate answer: Where are you from?

explanation.en: The question asks about origin.
explanation.ru: Вопрос спрашивает о происхождении.
explanation.kk: Сұрақ шығу тегін сұрайды.

questions.question: Read: My name is Lina. I study biology and share a flat with my cousin. Who lives with Lina?

explanation.en: The text says she shares a flat with her cousin.
explanation.ru: В тексте сказано, что она снимает квартиру вместе с двоюродной сестрой (двоюродным братом).
explanation.kk: Мәтінде ол пәтерді немере әпкесімен (немере ағасымен) бірге бөлісіп тұрады делінген.

questions.question: Choose the question that matches this answer. “I’m looking for my student card.”

explanation.en: In a direct question, are comes before you. The verb phrase is look for.
explanation.ru: В прямом вопросе are стоит перед you. Глагольное сочетание — look for.
explanation.kk: Тура сұрақта are you-дің алдына қойылады. Етістік тіркесі — look for.

options.text: What do you look for yesterday?

questions.question: A new student says, “I got here on the number 14 bus.” Which question is she answering?

explanation.en: The bus tells us how she travelled.
explanation.ru: Слово bus показывает, как она добиралась.
explanation.kk: Bus сөзі оның қалай барғанын көрсетеді.

questions.question: Complete the question. “Which language ___ at home, Aida?”

explanation.en: Use do + subject + base verb for this present simple question.
explanation.ru: Для этого вопроса в present simple используйте do + подлежащее + глагол в начальной форме.
explanation.kk: Present simple-дағы бұл сұрақ үшін do + бастауыш + етістіктің негізгі формасы қолданылады.

questions.question: At registration, the tutor wants to know which class a student is in. Which question should she ask?

explanation.en: Which group asks for the group name or number.
explanation.ru: Which group спрашивает название или номер группы.
explanation.kk: Which group топтың атауын немесе нөмірін сұрайды.

questions.question: Complete the usual verb phrase. “I always ___ a shower after basketball practice.”

explanation.en: Have a shower is a common phrase in British English.
explanation.ru: Have a shower — распространённое выражение в британском английском.
explanation.kk: Have a shower — британ ағылшынында жиі қолданылатын тіркес.

questions.question: Which set of letters is read “ess, double-u, jay”?

explanation.en: These are the English names of S, W and J, in order.
explanation.ru: Это английские названия букв S, W и J по порядку.
explanation.kk: Бұл S, W және J әріптерінің ағылшынша аталуы, сол реттілікпен.

questions.question: A club form asks for your “surname”, but you are unsure what the word means. Which question will help?

explanation.en: What does a word mean? is the standard way to ask about its meaning.
explanation.ru: What does a word mean? — стандартный способ спросить о значении слова.
explanation.kk: What does a word mean? — сөздің мағынасын сұраудың стандартты тәсілі.

options.text: Where does a surname go to?

questions.question: Complete: My brother ___ in a bank.

explanation.en: Use the -s form with a third-person singular subject.
explanation.ru: С подлежащим в 3-м лице единственного числа используйте форму на -s.
explanation.kk: Жекеше 3-жақтағы бастауышпен -s формасы қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: We ___ near the university.

explanation.en: Use the base form with we in the present simple.
explanation.ru: С we в present simple используйте начальную форму.
explanation.kk: Present simple-де we-мен етістіктің негізгі формасы қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: Eva ___ coffee; she prefers tea.

explanation.en: After doesn't, use the base form drink.
explanation.ru: После doesn't используйте начальную форму drink.
explanation.kk: Doesn't-тен кейін негізгі форма drink қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: ___ your parents work on Saturdays?

explanation.en: Use do with the plural subject your parents.
explanation.ru: С подлежащим во множественном числе your parents используйте do.
explanation.kk: Көпше бастауыш your parents-пен do қолданылады.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.

explanation.en: Present simple third-person singular needs walks.
explanation.ru: Для 3-го лица единственного числа в present simple нужно walks.
explanation.kk: Present simple-де жекеше 3-жаққа walks қажет.

options.text: He does usually walks to work.
He walks usually to work does.

questions.question: Complete: My teacher is ___ late; she always arrives early.

explanation.en: Never fits the meaning of arriving early every time.
explanation.ru: Never подходит по смыслу к ситуации, когда человек всегда приходит рано.
explanation.kk: Never әр жолы ерте келу мағынасына сәйкес келеді.

questions.question: Complete: How often ___ she visit her grandparents?

explanation.en: Use does with she in a present simple question.
explanation.ru: С she в вопросе present simple используйте does.
explanation.kk: Present simple сұрағында she-мен does қолданылады.

questions.question: Choose the correct short answer: Does Mark like chess?

explanation.en: Match the auxiliary does in the question.
explanation.ru: Выберите вспомогательный глагол does, как в вопросе.
explanation.kk: Сұрақтағыдай көмекші етістік does таңдаңыз.

questions.question: Complete: The shop ___ at nine every weekday.

explanation.en: A regular schedule can use the present simple.
explanation.ru: Для регулярного расписания можно использовать present simple.
explanation.kk: Тұрақты кесте үшін present simple қолдануға болады.

questions.question: Complete: I ___ wear a tie to my classes.

explanation.en: Use don't with I before a base verb.
explanation.ru: С I перед начальной формой глагола используйте don't.
explanation.kk: I-мен етістіктің негізгі формасының алдында don't қолданылады.

questions.question: Choose the correct negative sentence.

explanation.en: Doesn't is followed by the base form drive.
explanation.ru: После doesn't идёт начальная форма drive.
explanation.kk: Doesn't-тен кейін негізгі форма drive тұрады.

questions.question: Complete: ___ does your uncle do? — He is a chef.

explanation.en: What does someone do asks about their job.
explanation.ru: What does someone do спрашивает о работе человека.
explanation.kk: What does someone do адамның жұмысын сұрайды.

questions.question: Complete: The students ___ English twice a week.

explanation.en: A plural subject takes study.
explanation.ru: Подлежащее во множественном числе требует study.
explanation.kk: Көпше бастауыш study формасын талап етеді.

questions.question: Read: Omar cycles to college from Monday to Friday. He takes the bus on Saturday. How does he travel on weekdays?

explanation.en: Monday to Friday are weekdays, when Omar cycles.
explanation.ru: С понедельника по пятницу — будние дни, когда Omar ездит на велосипеде.
explanation.kk: Дүйсенбіден жұмаға дейін — Omar велосипедпен жүретін жұмыс күндері.

questions.question: A person who likes giving things to other people is ___.

explanation.en: Generous describes willingness to give or share.
explanation.ru: Generous описывает готовность давать или делиться.
explanation.kk: Generous бөлісуге, беруге дайын болуды сипаттайды.

questions.question: A person who does not like doing much work is ___.

explanation.en: Lazy means unwilling to work or make an effort.
explanation.ru: Lazy значит нежелающий работать или прилагать усилия.
explanation.kk: Lazy — жұмыс істегісі немесе күш салғысы келмейтін дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: A person who finds it difficult to talk to strangers may be ___.

explanation.en: Shy describes nervousness in social situations.
explanation.ru: Shy описывает робость в общении с людьми.
explanation.kk: Shy әлеуметтік жағдайларда ұялшақтықты сипаттайды.

questions.question: Someone who tells the truth is ___.

explanation.en: Honest describes truthful behaviour.
explanation.ru: Honest описывает правдивое поведение.
explanation.kk: Honest шыншыл мінез-құлықты сипаттайды.

questions.question: Complete: My sister has long, ___ hair, with no curls.

explanation.en: Straight hair does not have curls.
explanation.ru: Straight hair — прямые волосы без завитков.
explanation.kk: Straight hair — бұйра емес, тіп-тік шаш.

questions.question: Which question asks about appearance rather than personality?

explanation.en: Look like asks about physical appearance.
explanation.ru: Look like спрашивает о внешности.
explanation.kk: Look like сыртқы келбетті сұрайды.

options.text: What is he like as a person?

questions.question: Which question asks about someone's character?

explanation.en: Be like can ask for a description of personality.
explanation.ru: Be like может спрашивать описание характера.
explanation.kk: Be like мінезді сипаттауды сұрауы мүмкін.

options.text: What is your new flatmate like?

questions.question: In which word is the final -s pronounced /s/?

explanation.en: After the voiceless /k/, the ending is /s/.
explanation.ru: После глухого /k/ окончание — /s/.
explanation.kk: Қатаң /k/-дан кейін жалғау /s/ болады.

questions.question: In which word is the final -s pronounced /ɪz/?

explanation.en: After /tʃ/, the ending adds the syllable /ɪz/.
explanation.ru: После /tʃ/ окончание добавляет слог /ɪz/.
explanation.kk: /tʃ/-тан кейін жалғау /ɪz/ буынын қосады.

questions.question: Choose the best reply: What is your new classmate like? — He is very ___. He always says please and thank you.

explanation.en: The behaviour described is polite.
explanation.ru: Описанное поведение — вежливое.
explanation.kk: Сипатталған мінез-құлық — сыпайы.

questions.question: Complete the sentence about a regular habit. “On Fridays, Sam ___ his brother to school.”

explanation.en: With he or she, change a consonant + y to -ies in carries.
explanation.ru: С he или she согласная + y меняется на -ies: carries.
explanation.kk: He немесе she-мен жуан дауыссыз + y -ies-ке ауысады: carries.

questions.question: Choose the correct reply. “Do your neighbours work from home?” “Yes, ___.”

explanation.en: The subject is plural, and the short answer repeats do.
explanation.ru: Подлежащее во множественном числе, поэтому в краткий ответ повторяется do.
explanation.kk: Бастауыш көпше, сондықтан қысқа жауапта do қайталанады.

questions.question: “Jamil likes meeting new people and starts conversations easily.” Which word describes him best?

explanation.en: An outgoing person enjoys meeting people and talking to them.
explanation.ru: Общительный человек любит знакомиться с людьми и разговаривать с ними.
explanation.kk: Ашық-жарқын адам адамдармен танысып, сөйлесуді жақсы көреді.

questions.question: Which phrase describes physical appearance?

explanation.en: Hair length and shape are details of appearance.
explanation.ru: Длина и форма волос — детали внешности.
explanation.kk: Шаштың ұзындығы мен пішіні — сыртқы келбеттің бөлшектері.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that asks about frequency.

explanation.en: How often asks how frequently something happens.
explanation.ru: How often спрашивает, как часто что-то происходит.
explanation.kk: How often бір нәрсенің қаншалықты жиі болатынын сұрайды.

options.text: How many stops does the bus have?
How far does Dina walk to the bus stop?
How long does the bus ride take?
How much is Dina’s bus ticket?
How often does Dina miss the bus?

questions.question: What do the present simple forms “fixes” and “misses” have in common?

explanation.en: Fix ends in /ks/ and miss ends in /s/. Adding -es gives an extra /ɪz/ syllable.
explanation.ru: Fix оканчивается на /ks/, а miss — на /s/. Добавление -es даёт лишний слог /ɪz/.
explanation.kk: Fix /ks/-пен, ал miss /s/-пен аяқталады. -es қосқанда қосымша /ɪz/ буыны пайда болады.

options.text: Both endings are pronounced /z/ with no extra syllable.
Each gains an extra syllable pronounced /ɪz/.
Both endings are pronounced /s/ with no extra syllable.
Both words lose their final consonant.

questions.question: Read the profile. “Liam rarely speaks in large meetings. In small groups, he listens carefully and makes sure everyone has a turn.” Which description fits the second sentence?

explanation.en: He thinks about other people’s needs and gives them time to speak.
explanation.ru: Он думает о потребностях других людей и даёт им время высказаться.
explanation.kk: Ол басқа адамдардың қажеттілігін ойлайды және оларға сөйлеуге уақыт береді.

questions.question: Complete: Look! The children ___ in the garden.

explanation.en: Present continuous uses are + -ing with a plural subject.
explanation.ru: Present continuous образуется с are + -ing при подлежащем во множественном числе.
explanation.kk: Present continuous көпше бастауышпен are + -ing арқылы жасалады.

questions.question: Complete: I ___ a blue jacket today.

explanation.en: Use am + wearing with I.
explanation.ru: С I используйте am + wearing.
explanation.kk: I-мен am + wearing қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: Please be quiet. The baby ___.

explanation.en: Use is + -ing for an action in progress.
explanation.ru: Для действия в процессе используйте is + -ing.
explanation.kk: Жүріп жатқан іс-әрекет үшін is + -ing қолданылады.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.

explanation.en: Present continuous questions put are before you.
explanation.ru: В вопросах present continuous are стоит перед you.
explanation.kk: Present continuous сұрақтарында are you-дің алдына қойылады.

questions.question: Choose the correct negative sentence about watching television now.

explanation.en: Use aren't + -ing with they.
explanation.ru: С they используйте aren't + -ing.
explanation.kk: They-мен aren't + -ing қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: At the moment, Leo ___ an email.

explanation.ru: Выражение — in the evening.
explanation.kk: Тіркес — in the evening.

questions.question: Complete: Many people sleep ___ night.

explanation.en: The usual phrase is at night.
explanation.ru: Обычное выражение — at night.
explanation.kk: Жиі қолданылатын тіркес — at night.

questions.question: Complete: The keys are ___ my bag, inside its front pocket.

explanation.en: In describes an enclosed location.
explanation.ru: In описывает нахождение внутри замкнутого пространства.
explanation.kk: In жабық кеңістіктің ішіндегі орынды сипаттайды.

questions.question: Complete: We met ___ the bus stop, at the place where the bus collects passengers.

explanation.en: At identifies a point or meeting location.
explanation.ru: At указывает на точку или место встречи.
explanation.kk: At нүктені немесе кездесу орнын көрсетеді.

questions.question: Complete: The photo is hanging ___ the wall.

explanation.en: Use on for attachment to a wall.
explanation.ru: Для крепления к стене используйте on.
explanation.kk: Қабырғаға бекітілген нәрсе үшін on қолданылады.

questions.question: In unstressed British pronunciation, which is a common weak form of were?

explanation.en: Were commonly has the weak form /wə/ when unstressed.
explanation.ru: Were в безударной позиции обычно имеет слабую форму /wə/.
explanation.kk: Were екпінсіз жағдайда әдетте /wə/ әлсіз формасында айтылады.

questions.question: Complete the sentence. “At half past seven yesterday, Farida and I ___ for a map at the station.”

explanation.en: The subject Farida and I takes were. The -ing form describes the activity in progress.
explanation.ru: Подлежащее Farida and I требует were. Форма на -ing описывает действие в процессе.
explanation.kk: Бастауыш Farida and I were талап етеді. -ing формасы жүріп жатқан іс-әрекетті сипаттайды.

questions.question: “While the hotel staff were serving breakfast, the lights suddenly ___ out.”

explanation.en: Use the past simple went for the sudden event during another action.
explanation.ru: Для внезапного события во время другого действия используйте past simple went.
explanation.kk: Басқа іс-әрекет кезіндегі кенет оқиға үшін past simple went қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete the sentence about a date. “The photo was taken ___ 14 September.”

explanation.en: Use on before a specific date.
explanation.ru: Перед конкретной датой используется on.
explanation.kk: Нақты күннің алдында on қолданылады.

questions.question: Which phrase completes the usual time expression? “The streets were empty ___ the early morning, around five.”

explanation.en: The usual expression is in the early morning.
explanation.ru: Обычное выражение: in the early morning.
explanation.kk: Әдеттегі тіркес: in the early morning.

questions.question: In standard British English, which is the usual weak form of “was” in an unstressed sentence such as “I was waiting”?

explanation.en: Unstressed was commonly has the schwa /ə/ and keeps the final /z/.
explanation.ru: В безударной позиции was обычно содержит шва /ə/ и сохраняет конечный /z/.
explanation.kk: Екпінсіз was әдетте шва /ə/ дыбысын қамтиды және соңғы /z/ дыбысын сақтайды.

questions.question: Choose the best answer to “What were they doing when the bus arrived?”

explanation.en: The question asks about the action already in progress at that past moment.
explanation.ru: Вопрос о действии, которое уже шло в тот момент в прошлом.
explanation.kk: Сұрақ өткендегі сол сәтте жүріп жатқан іс-әрекет туралы.

options.text: They were looking at the timetable.
They have a map in their bag.

questions.question: Read the message. “At nine, Lena was crossing the bridge. As she was crossing, her phone rang.” Which event interrupted the other activity?

explanation.en: The phone rang during the longer activity of crossing the bridge.
explanation.ru: Телефон зазвонил во время более длительного действия: пока переходили мост.
explanation.kk: Телефон ұзағырақ іс-әрекет, яғни көпірден өту кезінде шылдырады.

options.text: She reached the far side of the bridge.

questions.question: Complete: ___, I packed my bag. Then I called a taxi.

explanation.en: First introduces the first step of a sequence.
explanation.ru: First вводит первый шаг последовательности.
explanation.kk: First реттіліктің бірінші қадамын енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete: We checked in. ___, we went through security.

explanation.en: Then introduces the next event.
explanation.ru: Then вводит следующее событие.
explanation.kk: Then келесі оқиғаны енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete: We waited for two hours. ___, the bus arrived.

explanation.en: Finally introduces the last or long-awaited event.
explanation.ru: Finally вводит последнее или долгожданное событие.
explanation.kk: Finally соңғы немесе ұзақ күткен оқиғаны енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete: I stayed at home ___ I felt ill.

explanation.en: Because introduces the reason.
explanation.ru: Because вводит причину.
explanation.kk: Because себепті енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete: It was raining, ___ we took an umbrella.

explanation.en: So introduces the result.
explanation.ru: So вводит результат.
explanation.kk: So нәтижені енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete: The room was small, ___ it was comfortable.

explanation.en: But introduces a contrast.
explanation.ru: But вводит противопоставление.
explanation.kk: But қарсы мәнді енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete: ___ it was cold, we enjoyed the walk.

explanation.en: Although introduces a contrast with the main clause.
explanation.ru: Although вводит противопоставление главному предложению.
explanation.kk: Although басты сөйлемге қарсы мәнді енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete: I washed my hands ___ I ate the sandwich.

explanation.en: Before places one action earlier than another.
explanation.ru: Before ставит одно действие раньше другого.
explanation.kk: Before бір іс-әрекетті екіншісінен бұрын орналастырады.

questions.question: Complete: ___ dinner, we went for a short walk.

explanation.en: After can be followed directly by the noun dinner.
explanation.ru: После After можно сразу поставить существительное dinner.
explanation.kk: After-тен кейін dinner зат есімін тікелей қоюға болады.

questions.question: Read: I missed the bus because I got up late. Why did I miss the bus?

explanation.en: The reason is explicitly given after because.
explanation.ru: Причина прямо названа после because.
explanation.kk: Себеп because-тен кейін тікелей аталған.

questions.question: Read: First we bought tickets. Then we found our seats. Finally the film began. What happened second?

explanation.en: Then marks the second event.
explanation.ru: Then отмечает второе событие.
explanation.kk: Then екінші оқиғаны белгілейді.

questions.question: Read: I was tired, but I finished the report. Did I finish it?

explanation.en: But contrasts tiredness with completing the report.
explanation.ru: But противопоставляет усталость и завершение отчёта.
explanation.kk: But шаршауды есепті аяқтаумен қарама-қарсы қояды.

options.text: The text says I never started.
Only after my friend finished it.

questions.question: Read: The train left before we reached the station. Which happened first?

explanation.en: Before places the departure earlier than the arrival.
explanation.ru: Before ставит отправление раньше прибытия.
explanation.kk: Before жолға шығуды келуден бұрын орналастырады.

options.text: We bought food at the station.

questions.question: Read: Anna dropped her keys. A boy picked them up and gave them back. Who returned the keys?

explanation.en: The boy picked up and returned the keys.
explanation.ru: Мальчик поднял и вернул ключи.
explanation.kk: Бала кілттерді көтеріп алып, қайтарды.

questions.question: Read: I could not open the door, so I called my flatmate. What was the result of the problem?

explanation.en: So introduces the resulting action.
explanation.ru: So вводит действие-результат.
explanation.kk: So нәтиже болатын әрекетті енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete the phrase: ___ a mistake.

explanation.en: The collocation is make a mistake.
explanation.ru: Устойчивое сочетание: make a mistake.
explanation.kk: Тұрақты тіркес: make a mistake.

questions.question: Complete the phrase: ___ the bus to college.

explanation.en: Take the bus means travel by bus.
explanation.ru: Take the bus значит ехать на автобусе.
explanation.kk: Take the bus автобуспен жүру дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: Please ___ me a call when you arrive.

explanation.en: The phrase is give someone a call.
explanation.ru: Выражение: give someone a call.
explanation.kk: Тіркес: give someone a call.

questions.question: Complete: We ___ a great time at the festival.

explanation.en: Have a great time means enjoy yourself.
explanation.ru: Have a great time значит хорошо провести время.
explanation.kk: Have a great time уақытты жақсы өткізу дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: I ___ my keys, so I could not get into the flat.

explanation.en: Lost fits the consequence of being unable to enter.
explanation.ru: Lost подходит как следствие невозможности войти.
explanation.kk: Lost кіре алмаудың салдары ретінде сәйкес келеді.

questions.question: In the word holiday, which syllable normally has primary stress?

explanation.en: Holiday is normally stressed on its first syllable.
explanation.ru: В слове holiday ударение обычно падает на первый слог.
explanation.kk: Holiday сөзінде екпін әдетте бірінші буынға түседі.

questions.question: In the word remember, which syllable has primary stress?

explanation.en: Remember is stressed on the second syllable.
explanation.ru: В слове remember ударение падает на второй слог.
explanation.kk: Remember сөзінде екпін екінші буынға түседі.

questions.question: Which word has primary stress on its second syllable?

explanation.en: Begin is stressed on the second syllable.
explanation.ru: В слове begin ударение падает на второй слог.
explanation.kk: Begin сөзінде екпін екінші буынға түседі.

questions.question: “We stopped for water ___ we continued walking.” Which word shows that the stop came first?

explanation.en: Before places the stop earlier than the next action.
explanation.ru: Before ставит остановку раньше следующего действия.
explanation.kk: Before аялдауды келесі іс-әрекеттен бұрын орналастырады.

questions.question: “The room was quiet ___ everyone could hear a clock in the hall.” Choose the connector that introduces the result.

explanation.en: So introduces what happened as a result of the room being quiet.
explanation.ru: So вводит то, что произошло в результате того, что в комнате было тихо.
explanation.kk: So бөлмедегі тыныштықтың нәтижесінде болған нәрсені енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete the usual phrase. “The driver slowed down to ___ a look at the sign.”

explanation.en: Take a look means to look at something, often briefly.
explanation.ru: Take a look значит посмотреть на что-то, часто мельком.
explanation.kk: Take a look бір нәрсеге қарау, көбіне жылдам қарау дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Which word has the main stress on the first syllable?

explanation.en: In picnic, the first syllable is stressed.
explanation.ru: В слове picnic ударение падает на первый слог.
explanation.kk: Picnic сөзінде екпін бірінші буынға түседі.

questions.question: Choose the connector. “___ Noor felt nervous, she went on stage and finished her speech.”

explanation.en: Although links an unexpected contrast: she went on stage despite feeling nervous.
explanation.ru: Although связывает неожиданное противопоставление: она вышла на сцену, несмотря на волнение.
explanation.kk: Although күтпеген қарама-қайшылықты байланыстырады: ол толқып тұрса да, сахнаға шықты.

questions.question: Read the notes. “First, we reached the campsite. Before putting up the tent, we phoned the owner. We cooked after the tent was ready.” Which action came immediately before they put up the tent?

explanation.en: Before putting up the tent, they phoned the owner.
explanation.ru: Before putting up the tent, they phoned the owner.
explanation.kk: Before putting up the tent, they phoned the owner.

questions.question: Read the story. “Mira missed her stop because she fell asleep. When she got off, she called her friend, who met her outside the station.” Why did Mira miss her stop?

explanation.en: Because introduces the reason she missed her stop.
explanation.ru: Because вводит причину, по которой она пропустила свою остановку.
explanation.kk: Because оның аялдамасын өткізіп алу себебін енгізеді.

options.text: She called her friend too early.
She wanted to buy a ticket.

questions.question: Complete with be going to: I ___ study tonight.

explanation.en: Use am going to with I.
explanation.ru: С I используется am going to.
explanation.kk: I-мен am going to қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete with be going to: They ___ visit their aunt.

explanation.en: Use are going to with they.
explanation.ru: С they используется are going to.
explanation.kk: They-мен are going to қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: She is going to ___ a new course.

explanation.en: Going to is followed by a base verb.
explanation.ru: После going to стоит глагол в базовой форме.
explanation.kk: Going to-дан кейін етістіктің негізгі формасы тұрады.

questions.question: Choose the correct question about a plan to travel alone.

explanation.en: Put are before the subject in this question.
explanation.ru: В этом вопросе are ставится перед подлежащим.
explanation.kk: Бұл сұрақта are бастауыштың алдына қойылады.

options.text: Is you going to travel alone?
Are going you to travel alone?
Do you going to travel alone?
Are you going to travel alone?

questions.question: Choose the correct negative sentence about a plan not to fly.

explanation.en: Use aren't going to with we.
explanation.ru: С we используется aren't going to.
explanation.kk: We-мен aren't going to қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: What ___ Amir going to do after class?

explanation.en: Use is with the singular subject Amir.
explanation.ru: С подлежащим Amir в единственном числе используется is.
explanation.kk: Жекеше бастауыш Amir-мен is қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: Are they going to stay? — Yes, they ___.

explanation.en: The short answer repeats are.
explanation.ru: В кратком ответе повторяется are.
explanation.kk: Қысқа жауапта are қайталанады.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that explicitly expresses a future intention with going to.

explanation.en: Be going to can express a future plan or intention.
explanation.ru: Be going to может выражать план или намерение на будущее.
explanation.kk: Be going to болашақтағы жоспар немесе ниетті білдіре алады.

options.text: I am going to learn French next year.
I have learned ten French words.
I am learning French right now.

questions.question: Complete: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.

explanation.en: Present evidence supports the prediction with going to.
explanation.ru: Явные признаки в настоящем подтверждают предсказание с going to.
explanation.kk: Қазіргі белгілер going to арқылы айтылған болжамды растайды.

questions.question: Complete: My parents are going to ___ a hotel online.

explanation.en: The main verb after going to stays in the base form.
explanation.ru: Основной глагол после going to остаётся в базовой форме.
explanation.kk: Going to-дан кейінгі негізгі етістік негізгі формада қалады.

questions.question: Choose the correct question about a plan.

explanation.en: Use question word + are + subject + going to + base verb.
explanation.ru: Используйте: вопросительное слово + are + подлежащее + going to + глагол в базовой форме.
explanation.kk: Мына үлгіні қолданыңыз: сұрау сөзі + are + бастауыш + going to + етістіктің негізгі формасы.

options.text: Where do you going to stay?
Where are you going to stay?
Where are going you to stay?
Where you are going to stay?

questions.question: Complete: I bought some vegetables because I ___ cook dinner.

explanation.en: The sentence describes a planned action with I.
explanation.ru: Предложение описывает запланированное действие с I.
explanation.kk: Сөйлем I-мен жоспарланған іс-әрекетті сипаттайды.

questions.question: Where do passengers usually leave checked suitcases before a flight?

explanation.en: Checked baggage is handed over before boarding.
explanation.ru: Сдаваемый в багаж чемодан сдают до посадки.
explanation.kk: Тапсырылатын жүк отырғызуға дейін тапсырылады.

questions.question: Which document usually shows the gate and seat for your flight?

explanation.en: A boarding pass contains flight boarding information.
explanation.ru: Посадочный талон содержит информацию о посадке на рейс.
explanation.kk: Boarding pass рейске отырғызу туралы ақпаратты қамтиды.

questions.question: What do passengers do at a departure gate?

explanation.en: The departure gate is the boarding point.
explanation.ru: Выход на посадку (departure gate) это место посадки.
explanation.kk: Departure gate отырғызу орны болып табылады.

options.text: Pick up checked bags after landing

questions.question: Which area do you usually visit to collect your checked suitcase after landing?

explanation.en: Baggage reclaim is for arriving passengers' checked luggage.
explanation.ru: Baggage reclaim предназначена для получения сданного багажа прибывающими пассажирами.
explanation.kk: Baggage reclaim келген жолаушылардың тапсырған жүгін алуға арналған.

questions.question: An airport screen says DELAYED. What does it mean?

explanation.en: Delayed means running behind schedule.
explanation.ru: Delayed значит отстающий от расписания.
explanation.kk: Delayed кестеден кешігіп жатыр дегенді білдіреді.

options.text: The flight has already landed on time.
The airport is changing its name.
The flight is later than planned.

questions.question: An airport screen says CANCELLED. What does it mean?

explanation.en: Cancelled means the scheduled service is not taking place.
explanation.ru: Cancelled значит, что запланированный рейс не состоится.
explanation.kk: Cancelled жоспарланған рейс орындалмайды дегенді білдіреді.

options.text: The baggage is already at home.
The ticket has a lower seat number.
The flight will not operate as scheduled.

questions.question: What is hand luggage?

explanation.en: Hand luggage travels with the passenger in the cabin.
explanation.ru: Ручная кладь (hand luggage) едет с пассажиром в салоне.
explanation.kk: Hand luggage жолаушымен бірге салонда жүреді.

options.text: Only a bag belonging to the pilot
Only goods bought after a flight
Only suitcases sent in the hold
Bags you take into the aircraft cabin

questions.question: Which verb means get onto a plane?

explanation.en: To board means to get onto a vehicle such as an aircraft.
explanation.ru: To board значит садиться на транспорт, например на самолёт.
explanation.kk: To board ұшақ сияқты көлікке отыру дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: In which word is g pronounced /dʒ/?

explanation.en: Gym begins with /dʒ/.
explanation.ru: Слово gym начинается со звука /dʒ/.
explanation.kk: Gym сөзі /dʒ/ дыбысынан басталады.

questions.question: In which word is g pronounced /ɡ/?

explanation.en: Gate begins with the hard g sound /ɡ/.
explanation.ru: Слово gate начинается с твёрдого звука g /ɡ/.
explanation.kk: Gate сөзі қатаң g дыбысынан /ɡ/ басталады.

questions.question: Read: Flight 218 was due at 14:00, but the screen now shows 15:30. How long is the delay?

explanation.en: The difference between 14:00 and 15:30 is 90 minutes.
explanation.ru: Разница между 14:00 и 15:30 составляет 90 минут.
explanation.kk: 14:00 мен 15:30 арасындағы айырма 90 минут.

questions.question: Complete the sentence about their plan. “They’ve decided on a holiday by train. They ___ during the school break.”

explanation.en: They takes are, followed by going to and the base verb.
explanation.ru: С they используется are, затем going to и глагол в базовой форме.
explanation.kk: They-мен are қолданылады, одан кейін going to және етістіктің негізгі формасы келеді.

questions.question: “Look at those dark clouds. It ___ rain.” Which phrase makes a prediction based on what you can see?

explanation.en: Be going to can express a prediction based on present evidence.
explanation.ru: Be going to может выражать предсказание на основе очевидных признаков в настоящем.
explanation.kk: Be going to қазіргі белгілерге негізделген болжамды білдіре алады.

questions.question: At the airport, what does “proceed to gate 12” ask passengers to do?

explanation.en: Passengers go to their departure gate to board the flight.
explanation.ru: Пассажиры идут к выходу на посадку, чтобы сесть на рейс.
explanation.kk: Жолаушылар рейске отыру үшін ұшуға шығатын шығу есігіне барады.

options.text: Buy a ticket at the information desk.
Go to the place where they will board.

questions.question: Where do passengers normally show items for safety screening after check-in?

explanation.en: Passengers and their hand luggage are screened at security.
explanation.ru: Пассажиров и их ручную кладь проверяют на досмотре.
explanation.kk: Жолаушылар мен олардың қол жүгі қауіпсіздік тексеруінде тексеріледі.

options.text: At a boarding gate after the flight

questions.question: Which word starts with /dʒ/, the same first sound as “giant”?

explanation.en: Gentle begins with the soft g sound /dʒ/.
explanation.ru: Слово gentle начинается с мягкого звука g /dʒ/.
explanation.kk: Gentle сөзі жұмсақ g дыбысынан /dʒ/ басталады.

questions.question: What does “connecting flight” mean?

explanation.en: A connecting flight takes you from an intermediate airport towards your destination.
explanation.ru: Стыковочный рейс везёт вас из промежуточного аэропорта к пункту назначения.
explanation.kk: Connecting flight сізді аралық әуежайдан баратын жеріңізге апарады.

options.text: A flight that returns to its starting airport without landing
A flight used only by airport workers
A later flight you take to continue the same journey
A flight for people who have missed check-in
A bus to the arrival hall

questions.question: Read the notice. “Flight 406 now leaves from gate 22. Boarding starts at 17:10. The departure time is still 17:40.” What has changed?

explanation.en: Now leaves from gate 22 signals the new gate. The departure time is unchanged.
explanation.ru: Now leaves from gate 22 указывает на новый выход. Время вылета не изменилось.
explanation.kk: Now leaves from gate 22 жаңа шығу есігін көрсетеді. Ұшу уақыты өзгермеген.

questions.question: Complete in the present continuous for an arrangement: We ___ our tutor tomorrow.

explanation.en: Use are meeting with we.
explanation.ru: С we используется are meeting.
explanation.kk: We-мен are meeting қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete in the present continuous: She ___ to Astana on Friday; her ticket is booked.

explanation.en: Use is flying with she for the arrangement.
explanation.ru: С she используется is flying для обозначения договорённости.
explanation.kk: She-мен келісім үшін is flying қолданылады.

questions.question: Choose the correct question about an arrangement.

explanation.en: Present continuous questions put the auxiliary before the subject.
explanation.ru: В вопросах Present Continuous вспомогательный глагол стоит перед подлежащим.
explanation.kk: Present Continuous сұрақтарында көмекші етістік бастауыштың алдына қойылады.

options.text: What time you are leaving tomorrow?
What time are you leave tomorrow?
What time are you leaving tomorrow?
What time is you leaving tomorrow?
What time do you leaving tomorrow?

questions.question: Choose the present continuous negative about tomorrow.

explanation.en: Am not + -ing is the correct negative with I.
explanation.ru: Am not + -ing это правильное отрицание с I.
explanation.kk: Am not + -ing I-мен дұрыс болымсыз форма.

questions.question: Which context clearly supports a fixed future arrangement?

explanation.en: A booking and a specified time indicate an arrangement.
explanation.ru: Бронирование и указанное время говорят о договорённости.
explanation.kk: Брондау және нақты уақыт келісім бар екенін көрсетеді.

options.text: We have booked a table and are meeting at eight.

questions.question: Complete: Are you seeing the dentist on Tuesday? — No, I ___.

explanation.en: Use am not in the short answer with I.
explanation.ru: В кратком ответе с I используется am not.
explanation.kk: I-мен қысқа жауапта am not қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: Who ___ you having lunch with tomorrow?

explanation.en: The auxiliary for you in the present continuous is are.
explanation.ru: Вспомогательный глагол для you в Present Continuous это are.
explanation.kk: Present Continuous-те you үшін көмекші етістік are болады.

questions.question: Complete: Nina and I ___ travelling together next week.

explanation.en: Nina and I is equivalent to we.
explanation.ru: Nina and I равносильно we.
explanation.kk: Nina and I we-ге тең.

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling: He is ___ his friends at six.

explanation.en: The -ing form of meet is meeting.
explanation.ru: Форма с -ing от meet это meeting.
explanation.kk: Meet етістігінің -ing формасы meeting.

questions.question: Read: I can't play tennis at five. I'm taking my mother to the doctor then. Why can't I play?

explanation.en: The speaker has an arrangement at the same time.
explanation.ru: У говорящего есть договорённость на это же время.
explanation.kk: Сөйлеушінің дәл сол уақытқа келісімі бар.

questions.question: Read: Dana is meeting Asel on Thursday, not Wednesday. On which day are they meeting?

explanation.en: The corrected day is Thursday.
explanation.ru: Исправленный день это Thursday.
explanation.kk: Түзетілген күн Thursday.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the present continuous for a future arrangement?

explanation.en: The form and tomorrow identify a future arrangement.
explanation.ru: Форма глагола и слово tomorrow указывают на договорённость в будущем.
explanation.kk: Етістік формасы мен tomorrow сөзі болашақтағы келісімді көрсетеді.

options.text: We have just finished a meeting.
We were having a meeting at ten.
We have a meeting every week.
We are having a meeting at ten tomorrow.

questions.question: Complete: We are waiting ___ the bus.

explanation.en: The phrase is wait for something.
explanation.ru: Выражение: wait for something.
explanation.kk: Тіркес: wait for something.

questions.question: Complete: She is talking ___ her sister on the phone.

explanation.en: Talk to identifies the other person in the conversation.
explanation.ru: Talk to указывает на собеседника.
explanation.kk: Talk to әңгімелесушіні көрсетеді.

questions.question: Complete: I agree ___ you about the plan.

explanation.en: Agree with someone expresses shared opinion.
explanation.ru: Agree with someone выражает общее мнение.
explanation.kk: Agree with someone ортақ пікірді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: Do you believe ___ ghosts?

explanation.en: Believe in means think something exists.
explanation.ru: Believe in значит считать, что что-то существует.
explanation.kk: Believe in бір нәрсенің бар екеніне сену дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: This bag belongs ___ my cousin.

explanation.en: Belong to indicates ownership.
explanation.ru: Belong to указывает на принадлежность.
explanation.kk: Belong to меншікті көрсетеді.

questions.question: Complete: Please ask the receptionist ___ help.

explanation.en: Ask someone for help is the standard phrase.
explanation.ru: Ask someone for help это стандартное выражение.
explanation.kk: Ask someone for help стандартты тіркес.

questions.question: Complete: She apologised ___ arriving late.

explanation.en: Apologise for introduces the reason for the apology.
explanation.ru: Apologise for вводит причину извинения.
explanation.kk: Apologise for кешірім сұрау себебін енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete: We arrived ___ the station before the train left.

explanation.en: Use arrive at for a point such as a station.
explanation.ru: Arrive at используется для точки, например станции.
explanation.kk: Arrive at бекет сияқты нақты пункт үшін қолданылады.

questions.question: Choose the best reply: Are you free on Saturday afternoon?

explanation.en: The reply accepts the possibility of making an arrangement.
explanation.ru: Ответ принимает возможность договориться.
explanation.kk: Жауап келісім жасау мүмкіндігін қабылдайды.

options.text: Yes. What time shall we meet?

questions.question: Choose the best reply: Let's meet outside the library at two.

explanation.en: The reply agrees to the proposed arrangement.
explanation.ru: Ответ соглашается с предложенной договорённостью.
explanation.kk: Жауап ұсынылған келісімге келіседі.

options.text: That sounds good. See you there.

questions.question: Choose a polite way to suggest a different meeting time.

explanation.en: The question politely proposes changing the time.
explanation.ru: Вопрос вежливо предлагает изменить время.
explanation.kk: Сұрақ уақытты өзгертуді сыпайы түрде ұсынады.

options.text: Could we meet at three instead?
You are never allowed to speak.
The ticket is in my pocket.
It is next to the bank.

questions.question: Complete the sentence about a future arrangement. “We have the tickets. We ___ the 7:20 train tomorrow.”

explanation.en: A booked arrangement can use the present continuous.
explanation.ru: Для заранее оговорённой договорённости можно использовать Present Continuous.
explanation.kk: Алдын ала келісілген жоспар үшін Present Continuous қолдануға болады.

questions.question: “Mila has booked an appointment for 3:30 tomorrow.” Choose the sentence that expresses this arrangement.

explanation.en: The present continuous plus a future time can express a booked arrangement.
explanation.ru: Present Continuous плюс указание будущего времени может выражать заранее оговорённую договорённость.
explanation.kk: Present Continuous мен болашақ уақыт көрсеткіші алдын ала келісілген жоспарды білдіре алады.

options.text: Mila saw the dentist at 3:30 last week.
Mila has never seen a dentist.
Mila is at the dentist right now.
Mila sees the dentist every month.
Mila is seeing the dentist at 3:30 tomorrow.

questions.question: Complete the usual expression. “Does this key belong ___ you?”

explanation.en: The verb belong is followed by to before the owner.
explanation.ru: После глагола belong перед владельцем стоит to.
explanation.kk: Belong етістігінен кейін иесінің алдында to тұрады.

questions.question: Complete the usual expression. “We need to agree ___ a date that works for everyone.”

explanation.en: Agree on a date means to choose a date together.
explanation.ru: Agree on a date значит выбрать дату вместе.
explanation.kk: Agree on a date күнді бірге таңдау дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete the usual expression. “Can I pay ___ the tickets now?”

explanation.en: Pay for is used before the thing you are buying.
explanation.ru: Pay for ставится перед тем, что вы покупаете.
explanation.kk: Pay for сатып алынатын нәрсенің алдында қолданылады.

questions.question: Read the messages. “Meet outside the pool at five?” “I finish work at five. What about 5:30 there?” What does the second speaker suggest changing?

explanation.en: There refers to the same place, and 5:30 is a new time.
explanation.ru: There указывает на то же место, а 5:30 это новое время.
explanation.kk: There сол бір орынды көрсетеді, ал 5:30 жаңа уақыт.

options.text: Both the time and the place

questions.question: A friend texts, “Shall we go to the exhibition on Tuesday?” You are free and want to accept. Which reply fits?

explanation.en: Tuesday works for me accepts the weekday proposed in the message.
explanation.ru: Tuesday works for me принимает день недели, предложенный в сообщении.
explanation.kk: Tuesday works for me хабарламада ұсынылған апта күнін қабылдайды.

options.text: Could we leave it for another week?
I’m not sure I can make it.

questions.question: Complete: A pilot is a person ___ flies planes.

explanation.en: Who introduces a defining clause about a person.
explanation.ru: Who вводит определительное придаточное о человеке.
explanation.kk: Who адам туралы анықтауыш бағыныңқы сөйлемді енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete: A dictionary is a book ___ explains words.

explanation.en: Which refers to a thing.
explanation.ru: Which относится к предмету.
explanation.kk: Which заттың орнына жүреді.

questions.question: Complete: A pharmacy is a place ___ you can buy medicine.

explanation.en: Where introduces a clause about a place.
explanation.ru: Where вводит придаточное о месте.
explanation.kk: Where орын туралы бағыныңқы сөйлемді енгізеді.

questions.question: Choose the correct definition of a chef.

explanation.en: Who can refer to the person doing the action.
explanation.ru: Who может относиться к человеку, совершающему действие.
explanation.kk: Who әрекетті орындаушы адамға қатысты бола алады.

options.text: A chef is someone which cooks food.
A chef is someone whose cooks food.
A chef is someone who cooks food.
A chef is someone where cooks food.
A chef is someone when cooks food.

questions.question: Complete: This is the app ___ helps me learn vocabulary.

explanation.en: That can refer to a thing in a defining clause.
explanation.ru: That может относиться к предмету в определительном придаточном.
explanation.kk: That анықтауыш бағыныңқы сөйлемде затқа қатысты бола алады.

questions.question: Complete: I know a shop ___ sells second-hand books.

explanation.en: The shop is the subject of sells, so which fits.
explanation.ru: Shop является подлежащим при sells, поэтому подходит which.
explanation.kk: Shop sells етістігінің бастауышы, сондықтан which сәйкес келеді.

questions.question: Complete: I know a shop ___ you can buy second-hand books.

explanation.en: Where expresses the location in which you can buy books.
explanation.ru: Where выражает место, где можно купить книги.
explanation.kk: Where кітап сатып алуға болатын орынды білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: The woman ___ lives next door is a musician.

explanation.en: The clause defines a person.
explanation.ru: Придаточное определяет человека.
explanation.kk: Бағыныңқы сөйлем адамды анықтайды.

questions.question: Complete: These are the shoes ___ I bought yesterday.

explanation.en: That can refer to the shoes in the defining clause.
explanation.ru: That может относиться к shoes в определительном придаточном.
explanation.kk: That анықтауыш бағыныңқы сөйлемде shoes сөзіне қатысты бола алады.

questions.question: Choose the correct definition of a library.

explanation.en: A library is a place for borrowing or consulting books.
explanation.ru: Библиотека это место, где берут книги или работают с ними.
explanation.kk: Кітапхана кітап алуға немесе пайдалануға арналған орын.

options.text: A place where you can borrow books

questions.question: Choose the correct definition of a mechanic.

explanation.en: The relative clause describes the work of a mechanic.
explanation.ru: Придаточное описывает работу механика.
explanation.kk: Бағыныңқы сөйлем механиктің жұмысын сипаттайды.

options.text: A place where you buy medicine

questions.question: Complete: A charger is something ___ you use to charge a phone.

explanation.en: Which refers to an object.
explanation.ru: Which относится к предмету.
explanation.kk: Which затқа қатысты.

questions.question: Complete: Is this the café ___ we met last week?

explanation.en: Where expresses the place of the meeting.
explanation.ru: Where выражает место встречи.
explanation.kk: Where кездесу орнын білдіреді.

questions.question: Choose the sentence without an unnecessary repeated subject.

explanation.en: Who is already the subject of the relative clause.
explanation.ru: Who уже является подлежащим придаточного предложения.
explanation.kk: Who қазірдің өзінде бағыныңқы сөйлемнің бастауышы.

options.text: I have a friend where he speaks three languages.
I have a friend who speaks three languages.
I have a friend who him speaks three languages.
I have a friend which he speaks three languages.
I have a friend who he speaks three languages.

questions.question: Which phrase helps explain a word you cannot remember?

explanation.en: A kind of gives a general category for paraphrasing.
explanation.ru: A kind of задаёт общую категорию при перефразировании.
explanation.kk: A kind of басқаша айтқанда жалпы санатты береді.

options.text: Do not listen to my description.
There are no words for it.
It is a kind of tool.

questions.question: You cannot remember scissors. Which description is clearest?

explanation.en: The description identifies the function of scissors.
explanation.ru: Описание указывает на функцию ножниц.
explanation.kk: Сипаттама қайшының қызметін анықтайды.

options.text: A place you go to catch a train
A person who repairs a roof
A tool you use to cut paper
A bag you use to carry clothes
A thing you use to drink water

questions.question: You cannot remember umbrella. Choose the best paraphrase.

explanation.en: The paraphrase explains an umbrella's function.
explanation.ru: Перефразирование объясняет функцию зонта.
explanation.kk: Басқаша айту қолшатырдың қызметін түсіндіреді.

options.text: A person who drives a bus
Something that keeps rain off you

questions.question: Which word means the same as inexpensive?

explanation.en: Inexpensive and cheap refer to a low price.
explanation.ru: Inexpensive и cheap обозначают низкую цену.
explanation.kk: Inexpensive және cheap төмен бағаны білдіреді.

questions.question: Which word is closest in meaning to tiny?

explanation.en: Tiny means extremely small.
explanation.ru: Tiny значит очень маленький.
explanation.kk: Tiny өте кішкентай дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Which description best identifies a kettle?

explanation.en: A kettle heats water to boiling point.
explanation.ru: Чайник нагревает воду до кипения.
explanation.kk: Шәйнек суды қайнағанша қыздырады.

options.text: Something you use to boil water
Something you wear on your feet
Something you use to iron shirts

questions.question: Choose the best paraphrase of crowded.

explanation.en: Crowded describes a place with many people.
explanation.ru: Crowded описывает место, где много людей.
explanation.kk: Crowded адам көп орынды сипаттайды.

questions.question: Which word normally has a silent final e?

explanation.en: The final e in name is not pronounced as a separate sound.
explanation.ru: Конечная e в name не произносится как отдельный звук.
explanation.kk: Name сөзіндегі соңғы e жеке дыбыс болып айтылмайды.

questions.question: Which word has the vowel sound /eɪ/ with a silent final e?

explanation.en: Cake has /eɪ/ and a silent final e.
explanation.ru: В cake звук /eɪ/ и немая конечная e.
explanation.kk: Cake сөзінде /eɪ/ дыбысы бар, соңғы e дыбысталмайды.

questions.question: Complete the definition with a relative word. “A charger is something ___ gives a battery power.”

explanation.en: That introduces the defining clause for a thing and is the subject of gives.
explanation.ru: That вводит определительное придаточное о предмете и является подлежащим при gives.
explanation.kk: That зат туралы анықтауыш бағыныңқы сөйлемді енгізеді және gives етістігінің бастауышы болады.

questions.question: Complete the definition. “An optician is a person ___ helps you choose glasses that fit.”

explanation.en: Who can introduce a clause defining a person.
explanation.ru: Who может вводить придаточное, определяющее человека.
explanation.kk: Who адамды анықтайтын бағыныңқы сөйлемді енгізе алады.

questions.question: Complete the definition with a single word. “A workshop is a room ___ people make or repair things.”

explanation.en: Where introduces a clause that describes what happens in a place.
explanation.ru: Where вводит придаточное о том, что происходит в каком-то месте.
explanation.kk: Where белгілі бір орында не болатынын сипаттайтын бағыныңқы сөйлемді енгізеді.

questions.question: Which explanation of “thermometer” has the right meaning?

explanation.en: A thermometer measures temperature.
explanation.ru: Термометр измеряет температуру.
explanation.kk: Термометр температураны өлшейді.

options.text: It’s a kind of room where food is kept cold.
It’s a machine that weighs bags.
It’s a person who fixes a heater.
It’s something you use to measure distance.
It’s something you use to measure temperature.

questions.question: Compare “hop” and “hope”. What changes when you add final e in this pair?

explanation.en: Hop and hope are both one syllable. The final e in hope is silent, and the vowel sound changes.
explanation.ru: Hop и hope оба односложные. Конечная e в hope не читается, а гласный звук меняется.
explanation.kk: Hop пен hope екеуі де бір буынды. Hope сөзіндегі соңғы e оқылмайды, ал дауысты дыбыс өзгереді.

options.text: The vowel sound stays exactly the same.
The sound at the start changes.
The vowel sound changes, and the word still has one syllable.
The final p is no longer pronounced.

questions.question: You cannot remember the word “ladder”. Which description will help someone identify it?

explanation.en: A ladder has steps you can climb to reach a higher place.
explanation.ru: У лестницы есть ступени, по которым можно подняться выше.
explanation.kk: Баспалдақтың сатылары бар, олармен жоғарырақ жерге көтерілуге болады.

options.text: It’s the place where you park a bike.
It’s something with steps that you climb to reach a high place.
It’s a person who cleans the windows.
It’s the cover you put on the floor to keep it clean.
It’s a type of seat you carry on a trip.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that identifies exactly which person you mean.

explanation.en: The who-clause singles out the neighbour by what they do.
explanation.ru: Придаточное с who выделяет соседа по тому, что он делает.
explanation.kk: Who-мен басталған бағыныңқы сөйлем көршіні оның істейтін ісі арқылы ажыратады.

options.text: That’s the neighbour who waters our plants when we’re away.
That’s a neighbour. Some people water plants.
I watered the plants before I left.
The neighbour has plants, and I have a garden.
There are neighbours on both sides of our house.

questions.question: Complete in the present perfect: I ___ finished my homework.

explanation.en: I takes have + past participle.
explanation.ru: С I используется have + причастие прошедшего времени.
explanation.kk: I-мен have + өткен шақ есімшесі қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete in the present perfect: She ___ cleaned the kitchen.

explanation.en: She takes has + past participle.
explanation.ru: С she используется has + причастие прошедшего времени.
explanation.kk: She-мен has + өткен шақ есімшесі қолданылады.

questions.question: Choose the past participle of see.

explanation.en: Seen is the participle used after have or has.
explanation.ru: Seen это причастие, которое используется после have или has.
explanation.kk: Seen have немесе has-тан кейін қолданылатын есімше.

questions.question: Choose the past participle of write.

explanation.en: Written is the past participle.
explanation.ru: Written это причастие прошедшего времени.
explanation.kk: Written өткен шақ есімшесі.

questions.question: Complete: Have you ___ the washing-up?

explanation.en: Present perfect requires the participle done.
explanation.ru: Present Perfect требует причастия done.
explanation.kk: Present Perfect done есімшесін талап етеді.

questions.question: Choose the correct present perfect negative.

explanation.en: Use hasn't + past participle with he.
explanation.ru: С he используется hasn't + причастие прошедшего времени.
explanation.kk: He-мен hasn't + өткен шақ есімшесі қолданылады.

options.text: He not has made his bed.

questions.question: Choose the correct present perfect question about taking out the rubbish.

explanation.en: Use have + subject + past participle.

questions.question: Complete the sentence. “Have the children ___ their rooms yet?”
