explanation.en: Confusing describes the source of the difficulty.
explanation.ru: Confusing описывает источник трудности.
explanation.kk: Confusing қиындықтың көзін сипаттайды.

questions.question: Complete: I am ___ because the directions are not clear.

explanation.en: Confused describes the person's state.
explanation.ru: Confused описывает состояние человека.
explanation.kk: Confused адамның күйін сипаттайды.

questions.question: Complete: She was ___ by the unexpected present.

explanation.en: Surprised describes the recipient's feeling.
explanation.ru: Surprised описывает чувство того, кто удивлён.
explanation.kk: Surprised таңғалған адамның сезімін сипаттайды.

questions.question: Complete: The news was ___. Nobody expected it.

explanation.en: Surprising describes news that creates surprise.
explanation.ru: Surprising описывает новость, которая вызывает удивление.
explanation.kk: Surprising таңғалдыратын жаңалықты сипаттайды.

questions.question: Read: Nobody wanted to go out, so we stayed home and cooked together. Where did we spend the evening?

explanation.en: The text says the group stayed home.
explanation.ru: В тексте сказано, что группа осталась дома.
explanation.kk: Мәтінде топ үйде қалды деп айтылған.

questions.question: Read: The walk was tiring, and I felt tired when I got home. Which word describes the walk?

explanation.en: The -ing adjective describes the activity causing tiredness.
explanation.ru: Прилагательное на -ing описывает занятие, из-за которого устают.
explanation.kk: -ing жалғаулы сын есім шаршататын іс-әрекетті сипаттайды.

questions.question: Read: There was something in my bag, but I didn't know what it was. What is certain?

explanation.en: Something indicates the existence of an unspecified object.
explanation.ru: Something указывает на существование неопределённого предмета.
explanation.kk: Something белгісіз заттың бар екенін білдіреді.

options.text: The speaker knew exactly what it was.
The bag contained an unidentified thing.
There was a person in the bag.

questions.question: Complete the sentence. “We tried all the cafés after ten, but there was ___ open.”

explanation.en: Nowhere open means there was no open place to go to.
explanation.ru: Nowhere open означает, что не было открытого места, куда можно пойти.
explanation.kk: Nowhere open баруға болатын ашық орын болмағанын білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete the question. “Would you like ___ to drink?”

explanation.en: Something is usual when offering food or a drink.
explanation.ru: Something обычно используют, когда предлагают еду или напиток.
explanation.kk: Something әдетте тамақ немесе сусын ұсынғанда қолданылады.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence about the group. The meaning should be that all its members agreed.

explanation.en: Everyone refers to every person in the group.
explanation.ru: Everyone относится к каждому человеку в группе.
explanation.kk: Everyone топтағы әр адамға қатысты.

options.text: No one in the group agreed.

questions.question: “We enjoyed the afternoon because the music made us feel calm.” Which word can complete “The music was ___”?

explanation.en: Relaxing describes something that causes a calm feeling.
explanation.ru: Relaxing описывает то, что вызывает спокойное чувство.
explanation.kk: Relaxing тыныштық сезімін тудыратын нәрсені сипаттайды.

questions.question: Complete the sentence about her reaction. “Nina was ___ when the concert was cancelled. She had waited weeks for it.”

explanation.en: Disappointed describes how Nina felt when her plan fell through.
explanation.ru: Disappointed описывает, что почувствовала Nina, когда её план сорвался.
explanation.kk: Disappointed Nina жоспары бұзылғанда не сезінгенін сипаттайды.

questions.question: Read the message. “I looked everywhere for my gloves. Nobody at the pool had seen them. When I came home, I found one of my gloves on each of the two kitchen chairs.” What do we learn at the end?

explanation.en: She found both of her gloves, one on each of the two chairs.
explanation.ru: Она нашла обе перчатки: по одной на каждом из двух стульев.
explanation.kk: Ол екі қолғабын да тапты: екі орындықтың әрқайсысында біреуден.

options.text: The gloves were left in a café.
The pool staff found both gloves.
At least one glove was still at the pool.
She decided to buy new gloves.

questions.question: Complete: My new bag is ___ than my old one.

explanation.en: Use the comparative bigger with than.
explanation.ru: Используйте сравнительную степень bigger с than.
explanation.kk: Than-мен салыстырмалы шырай bigger қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Complete: This exercise is ___ than the last one.

explanation.en: Easy changes to easier in the comparative.
explanation.ru: Easy в сравнительной степени меняется на easier.
explanation.kk: Easy салыстырмалы шырайда easier болып өзгереді.

questions.question: Complete: This course is ___ than that short workshop.

explanation.en: Longer adjectives commonly use more in the comparative.
explanation.ru: Длинные прилагательные обычно образуют сравнительную степень с more.
explanation.kk: Ұзын сын есімдер салыстырмалы шырайды әдетте more арқылы жасайды.

questions.question: Choose the comparative of good.

explanation.en: Good has the irregular comparative better.
explanation.ru: У good неправильная сравнительная степень better.
explanation.kk: Good сын есімінің салыстырмалы шырайы тұрақсыз: better.

questions.question: Choose the comparative of bad.

explanation.en: Bad has the irregular comparative worse.
explanation.ru: У bad неправильная сравнительная степень worse.
explanation.kk: Bad сын есімінің салыстырмалы шырайы тұрақсыз: worse.

questions.question: Complete: A bicycle is usually cheaper ___ a car.

explanation.en: Than introduces the second part of a comparison.
explanation.ru: Than вводит вторую часть сравнения.
explanation.kk: Than салыстырудың екінші бөлігін енгізеді.

questions.question: Complete: My brother drives ___ than I do.

explanation.en: Use the comparative adverb more carefully to describe drives.
explanation.ru: Чтобы описать манеру вождения, используйте сравнительную степень наречия more carefully.
explanation.kk: Көлік жүргізу мәнерін сипаттау үшін үстеудің салыстырмалы шырайы more carefully қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Complete: Please speak ___; I can't follow you.

explanation.en: More slowly is the comparative of slowly.
explanation.ru: More slowly — сравнительная степень от slowly.
explanation.kk: More slowly — slowly үстеуінің салыстырмалы шырайы.

questions.question: Complete: Amina runs ___ than her cousin.

explanation.en: Fast has the comparative form faster.
explanation.ru: У fast сравнительная степень faster.
explanation.kk: Fast сөзінің салыстырмалы шырайы faster.

questions.question: Complete: The second question is not as difficult ___ the first.

explanation.en: Use as ... as for this comparison pattern.
explanation.ru: Для этой конструкции сравнения используйте as ... as.
explanation.kk: Бұл салыстыру құрылымында as ... as қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparison of the warmth of two rooms.

explanation.en: Much can strengthen a comparative, but more warmer is a double comparative.
explanation.ru: Much может усиливать сравнительную степень, но more warmer — двойная сравнительная степень.
explanation.kk: Much салыстырмалы шырайды күшейте алады, бірақ more warmer — қос салыстырмалы шырай.

options.text: This room is more warmer than that one.
This room is much warmer than that one.
This room is much warmest than that one.
This room is most warmer than that one.
This room is warm than that one.

questions.question: Read: The train takes two hours and the bus takes three. Which is faster on this route?

explanation.en: The train takes less time.
explanation.ru: Поезд занимает меньше времени.
explanation.kk: Пойыз аз уақыт алады.

questions.question: Read: Box A weighs 4 kg and Box B weighs 7 kg. Which statement is true?

explanation.en: Seven kilograms is heavier than four.
explanation.ru: Семь килограммов тяжелее, чем четыре.
explanation.kk: Жеті келі төрт келіден ауыр.

options.text: Box B is lighter than Box A.
Box B is heavier than Box A.
Box A is heavier than Box B.

questions.question: Read: Noor types 50 words a minute and Asel types 60. Who types more quickly?

explanation.en: Asel types more words in the same time.
explanation.ru: Asel печатает больше слов за то же время.
explanation.kk: Asel бірдей уақытта көбірек сөз теріп жазады.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative of happy.

explanation.en: Change y to i before -er.
explanation.ru: Перед -er меняйте y на i.
explanation.kk: -er алдында y әрпін i-ге ауыстырыңыз.

questions.question: Choose the comparative of little when it refers to amount.

explanation.en: Less is the comparative for a smaller amount.
explanation.ru: Less — сравнительная степень для меньшего количества.
explanation.kk: Less — аз мөлшердің салыстырмалы шырайы.

questions.question: How do you read 21 as an ordinal number?

explanation.en: The ordinal form is twenty-first.
explanation.ru: Порядковое числительное — twenty-first.
explanation.kk: Реттік сан есім — twenty-first.

questions.question: How do you read 50%?

explanation.en: 50% is fifty per cent.
explanation.ru: 50% читается как fifty per cent.
explanation.kk: 50% fifty per cent деп оқылады.

questions.question: Which expression means 1/2?

explanation.en: A half is one of two equal parts.
explanation.ru: A half — одна из двух равных частей.
explanation.kk: A half — екі тең бөліктің бірі.

questions.question: Which number is written one thousand two hundred?

explanation.en: One thousand plus two hundred is 1,200.
explanation.ru: One thousand plus two hundred — это 1,200.
explanation.kk: One thousand plus two hundred — 1,200.

questions.question: Read: A laptop costs £600 and a tablet costs £450. How much more expensive is the laptop?

explanation.en: Subtract 450 from 600.
explanation.ru: Вычтите 450 из 600.
explanation.kk: 600-ден 450-ді алыңыз.

questions.question: Read: Route A is 8 km and takes 40 minutes. Route B is 10 km and takes 30 minutes. Which description is correct?

explanation.en: Route B has more kilometres but fewer minutes.
explanation.ru: У маршрута B больше километров, но меньше минут.
explanation.kk: B бағытында километр көп, бірақ минут аз.

options.text: Route B is shorter and slower.
Both routes are the same length.
Route A is longer and quicker.
Route B is longer but quicker.

questions.question: Read: Kim is 160 cm tall, Eva is 165 cm and Lina is 170 cm. Which sentence is correct?

explanation.en: Eva's height lies between the other two.
explanation.ru: Рост Eva находится между ростом двух других.
explanation.kk: Eva-ның бойы қалған екеуінің арасында.

options.text: Eva is taller than Kim but shorter than Lina.

questions.question: Complete the comparison. “A message by email reaches us ___ than a letter by post.”

explanation.en: Soon has the comparative form sooner, used before than.
explanation.ru: У soon сравнительная степень sooner, она используется перед than.
explanation.kk: Soon сөзінің салыстырмалы шырайы sooner, ол than алдында қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete the comparison. “This backpack is ___ than mine. It weighs only half as much.”

explanation.en: Use lighter to compare the lower weight of one backpack with another.
explanation.ru: Используйте lighter, чтобы сравнить меньший вес одного рюкзака с другим.
explanation.kk: Бір рюкзактың салмағының екіншісінен аз екенін салыстыру үшін lighter қолданыңыз.

questions.question: “Leo scored 84 per cent and Mia scored 72 per cent.” Which statement is true?

explanation.en: Eighty-four is greater than seventy-two.
explanation.ru: Eighty-four больше, чем seventy-two.
explanation.kk: Eighty-four seventy-two-ден үлкен.

options.text: Mia scored more than 84 per cent.
Leo’s score was higher than Mia’s.
Mia’s score was higher than Leo’s.

questions.question: Choose the correct way to read the fraction ¾.

explanation.en: In the fraction ¾, three of four equal parts are counted.
explanation.ru: В дроби ¾ берутся три из четырёх равных частей.
explanation.kk: ¾ бөлшегінде төрт тең бөліктің үшеуі алынады.

questions.question: Choose the correct way to read this phone-number segment digit by digit: 604.

explanation.en: Read each digit individually in the order shown.
explanation.ru: Читайте каждую цифру отдельно, в указанном порядке.
explanation.kk: Әр цифрды жеке, көрсетілген ретпен оқыңыз.

questions.question: One parcel weighs exactly 2 kg and a second parcel weighs exactly 2 kg. Which comparison is accurate?

explanation.en: As heavy as describes equal weight.
explanation.ru: As heavy as описывает одинаковый вес.
explanation.kk: As heavy as тең салмақты сипаттайды.

options.text: The first parcel is less heavy than the second.
The second parcel is twice as heavy.
The second parcel is lighter than the first.
The first parcel is as heavy as the second.
The first parcel is heavier than the second.

questions.question: Complete: This is ___ building in our town.

explanation.en: Use the + superlative tallest.
explanation.ru: Используйте the + превосходную степень tallest.
explanation.kk: The + күшейтпелі шырай tallest қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Choose the superlative of good.

explanation.en: Best is the irregular superlative.
explanation.ru: Best — неправильная превосходная степень.
explanation.kk: Best — тұрақсыз күшейтпелі шырай.

questions.question: Complete: It is ___ interesting museum I have visited.

explanation.en: Use the most with the superlative of interesting.
explanation.ru: Используйте the most с превосходной степенью от interesting.
explanation.kk: Interesting сөзінің күшейтпелі шырайында the most қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Choose the superlative of bad.

explanation.en: Worst is the irregular superlative.
explanation.ru: Worst — неправильная превосходная степень.
explanation.kk: Worst — тұрақсыз күшейтпелі шырай.

questions.question: Complete: Of the three hotels, this one is ___.

explanation.en: Use a superlative when comparing one item with the whole group.
explanation.ru: Используйте превосходную степень, когда сравниваете один предмет со всей группой.
explanation.kk: Бір затты бүкіл топпен салыстырғанда күшейтпелі шырайды қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Read: Lake A is 20 m deep, Lake B is 50 m and Lake C is 35 m. Which is the deepest?

explanation.en: Lake B has the greatest depth.
explanation.ru: У озера B самая большая глубина.
explanation.kk: B көлінің тереңдігі ең үлкен.

questions.question: Complete: There are ___ cars in the centre; the streets are crowded.

explanation.en: Cars is countable and plural, so use too many.
explanation.ru: Cars — исчисляемое существительное во множественном числе, поэтому используйте too many.
explanation.kk: Cars — санауға болатын көпше сан зат есім, сондықтан too many қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Complete: There is ___ traffic today. We are moving very slowly.

explanation.en: Traffic is uncountable, so use too much.
explanation.ru: Traffic — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому используйте too much.
explanation.kk: Traffic — санауға болмайтын зат есім, сондықтан too much қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Complete: We have ___ time, so we can walk instead of taking a taxi.

explanation.en: Enough time means sufficient time.
explanation.ru: Enough time означает достаточно времени.
explanation.kk: Enough time жеткілікті уақыт дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: There isn't ___ milk for three cups of tea.

explanation.en: Enough can modify uncountable milk.
explanation.ru: Enough может сочетаться с неисчисляемым существительным milk.
explanation.kk: Enough санауға болмайтын milk сөзімен қолданыла алады.

questions.question: Complete: I have ___ close friends — just two or three.

explanation.en: A few is used with plural countable friends.
explanation.ru: A few используется с исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе: friends.
explanation.kk: A few санауға болатын көпше сандағы friends сөзімен қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: Add ___ water, about a spoonful.

explanation.en: A little is used with uncountable water.
explanation.ru: A little используется с неисчисляемым существительным water.
explanation.kk: A little санауға болмайтын water сөзімен қолданылады.

questions.question: Complete: There is very ___ space in this lift, so we cannot all get in.

explanation.en: Space is uncountable in this context.
explanation.ru: В этом контексте space — неисчисляемое существительное.
explanation.kk: Бұл мағынада space — санауға болмайтын зат есім.

questions.question: Which part of the body connects your head to your shoulders?

explanation.en: The neck connects the head and trunk.
explanation.ru: Neck (шея) соединяет голову и туловище.
explanation.kk: Neck (мойын) бас пен тұлғаны байланыстырады.

questions.question: Which joint is between the upper and lower parts of the leg?

explanation.en: The knee is the leg joint named in the question.
explanation.ru: Knee (колено) — сустав ноги, о котором говорится в вопросе.
explanation.kk: Knee (тізе) — сұрақта айтылған аяқ буыны.

questions.question: Complete: I can't talk loudly because I have a sore ___.

explanation.en: A sore throat can make speaking uncomfortable.
explanation.ru: Sore throat (больное горло) может затруднять разговор.
explanation.kk: Sore throat (тамақтың ауруы) сөйлеуді ыңғайсыз етуі мүмкін.

questions.question: Which body part do you normally use to smell?

explanation.en: The nose is associated with the sense of smell.
explanation.ru: Nose (нос) связан с обонянием.
explanation.kk: Nose (мұрын) иіс сезумен байланысты.

questions.question: A town with little noise is ___.

explanation.en: Quiet describes a low level of noise.
explanation.ru: Quiet описывает низкий уровень шума.
explanation.kk: Quiet шудың төмен деңгейін сипаттайды.

questions.question: A city with many people in a small space is ___.

explanation.en: Crowded means full of people.
explanation.ru: Crowded означает «полный людей».
explanation.kk: Crowded адамға лық толы дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: There ___ a hospital next to the station.

explanation.en: Use there is with a singular noun.
explanation.ru: Используйте there is с существительным в единственном числе.
explanation.kk: There is-ті жекеше сандағы зат есіммен қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Complete: There ___ two parks near my home.

explanation.en: Use there are with a plural noun.
explanation.ru: Используйте there are с существительным во множественном числе.
explanation.kk: There are-ді көпше сандағы зат есіммен қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Complete: ___ there a pharmacy near here?

explanation.en: Invert is in the question with a singular noun.
explanation.ru: В вопросе с существительным в единственном числе is стоит перед there (инверсия).
explanation.kk: Жекеше сандағы зат есімі бар сұрақта is there алдына шығады (инверсия).

questions.question: Read: Town X has three parks and little traffic. Town Y has no parks and heavy traffic. Which statement is supported?

explanation.en: The comparison follows both pieces of information.
explanation.ru: Сравнение следует после обеих частей информации.
explanation.kk: Салыстыру екі ақпараттан кейін келеді.

options.text: Town X has more parks and less traffic.

questions.question: Complete the sentence. “Of the three streets, Mill Street is ___ in the evening. Hardly any cars use it.” Choose the superlative of quiet.

explanation.en: Hardly any cars suggests the street is quiet, and the superlative compares all three.
explanation.ru: Hardly any cars говорит о том, что улица тихая, а превосходная степень сравнивает все три.
explanation.kk: Hardly any cars көшенің тыныш екенін білдіреді, ал күшейтпелі шырай үшеуін де салыстырады.

questions.question: Complete the sentence about a café. “There aren’t ___ clean cups for all twelve guests. We need to wash three more.”

explanation.en: Enough means as many as are needed.
explanation.ru: Enough означает «столько, сколько нужно».
explanation.kk: Enough қажетті мөлшерде дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: A visitor needs a printed map and advice about local attractions. Which place is set up to provide both?

explanation.en: A tourist information centre provides visitors with maps and advice on local sights.
explanation.ru: Tourist information centre даёт посетителям карты и советы о местных достопримечательностях.
explanation.kk: Tourist information centre келушілерге карталар мен жергілікті көрікті жерлер туралы кеңестер береді.

questions.question: Which body part connects the hand to the forearm?

explanation.en: The wrist is the joint between the hand and the forearm.
explanation.ru: Wrist (запястье) — сустав между кистью и предплечьем.
explanation.kk: Wrist (білек) — қол басы мен білектің арасындағы буын.

questions.question: Complete the sentence about a small amount of an uncountable noun. “Put ___ water in the glass, just a small amount.”

explanation.en: Use a little with an uncountable noun such as water.
explanation.ru: Используйте a little с неисчисляемым существительным, например water.
explanation.kk: A little-ды water сияқты санауға болмайтын зат есіммен қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Read the options. “Central Clinic: 10 min by bus. North Clinic: 18 min by bus. Park Clinic: 15 min by bus.” Which clinic is quickest to reach by bus?

explanation.en: Ten minutes is the shortest of the three journey times.
explanation.ru: Ten minutes — самое короткое из трёх времён в пути.
explanation.kk: Ten minutes — жолдағы үш уақыттың ең қысқасы.

options.text: All three take the same time
North and Park take the same time

questions.question: Complete: I think it ___ rain tomorrow.

explanation.en: Will is followed directly by a base verb.
explanation.ru: После will сразу идёт базовая форма глагола.
explanation.kk: Will-дан кейін етістіктің негізгі формасы тікелей тұрады.

questions.question: Choose the correct negative form of will.

explanation.en: Won't is the standard contraction of will not.
explanation.ru: Won't — стандартное сокращение от will not.
explanation.kk: Won't — will not-тың стандартты қысқаша түрі.

questions.question: Complete: Don't worry. I ___ help you with the bags.

explanation.en: Will can introduce an offer of help.
explanation.ru: Will может вводить предложение помощи.
explanation.kk: Will көмек ұсынуды білдіре алады.

questions.question: Complete: She will ___ you after the lesson.

explanation.en: Use the base form after will.
explanation.ru: После will используйте базовую форму.
explanation.kk: Will-дан кейін негізгі форманы қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Choose the correct future question about being at home tonight.

explanation.en: Put will before the subject and use be.
explanation.ru: Поставьте will перед подлежащим и используйте be.
explanation.kk: Will-ді бастауыштың алдына қойып, be қолданыңыз.

options.text: Are you will at home tonight?
Will you to be at home tonight?
Will you be at home tonight?
Do you will be at home tonight?
Will be you at home tonight?

questions.question: Complete: Will they come? — Yes, they ___.

explanation.en: The short answer repeats will.
explanation.ru: Краткий ответ повторяет will.
explanation.kk: Қысқа жауап will-ді қайталайды.

questions.question: Complete: Will it snow? — No, it ___.

explanation.en: The negative short answer uses won't.
explanation.ru: В отрицательном кратком ответе используется won't.
explanation.kk: Болымсыз қысқа жауапта won't қолданылады.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that expresses a promise.

explanation.en: I promise explicitly marks the sentence as a promise.
explanation.ru: I promise прямо обозначает предложение как обещание.
explanation.kk: I promise сөйлемнің уәде екенін тікелей көрсетеді.

options.text: I will return your book tomorrow, I promise.
I returned your book last month.

questions.question: Complete the immediate decision: The phone is ringing. I ___ answer it.

explanation.en: Will commonly expresses a decision made at the moment of speaking.
explanation.ru: Will часто выражает решение, принятое в момент речи.
explanation.kk: Will көбіне сөйлеп тұрған сәтте қабылданған шешімді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: I don't think people ___ stop using the Internet soon.

explanation.en: After the subject, use will + base verb.
explanation.ru: После подлежащего используйте will + базовая форма глагола.
explanation.kk: Бастауыштан кейін will + етістіктің негізгі формасын қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Which sentence expresses a prediction?

explanation.en: A belief about a future result is a prediction.
explanation.ru: Убеждённость в будущем результате — это прогноз (prediction).
explanation.kk: Болашақ нәтиже туралы сенім — болжам (prediction).

options.text: Our team has a new coach.
I think our team will win.

questions.question: Choose a polite request using will.

explanation.en: Will you ... please can be a request.
explanation.ru: Will you ... please может быть просьбой.
explanation.kk: Will you ... please өтініш болуы мүмкін.

options.text: You close the door every day.
Will you close the door, please?

questions.question: Complete: We ___ be late; the station is only a minute away.

explanation.en: Won't is followed by the base form be.
explanation.ru: После won't идёт базовая форма be.
explanation.kk: Won't-тан кейін негізгі форма be тұрады.

questions.question: Choose the correct future sentence.

explanation.en: The future existential form is there will be.
explanation.ru: Будущее время конструкции «имеется, существует» — there will be.
explanation.kk: «Бар» мағынасындағы құрылымның болашақ түрі — there will be.

options.text: There will be more electric cars.
There are will more electric cars.
There will to be more electric cars.
There wills be more electric cars.
There will are more electric cars.

questions.question: What is the opposite of lend?

explanation.en: Lend means give temporarily; borrow means receive temporarily.
explanation.ru: Lend означает дать на время; borrow означает взять на время.
explanation.kk: Lend уақытша беруді білдіреді; borrow уақытша алуды білдіреді.

questions.question: What is the opposite of win?

explanation.en: Win and lose are opposite results in a competition.
explanation.ru: Win и lose — противоположные результаты в соревновании.
explanation.kk: Win және lose — жарыстағы қарама-қарсы нәтижелер.

questions.question: What is the opposite of turn on?

explanation.en: Turn off stops a device operating.
explanation.ru: Turn off останавливает работу устройства.
explanation.kk: Turn off құрылғының жұмысын тоқтатады.

questions.question: What is the opposite of remember?

explanation.en: Forget means fail to remember.
explanation.ru: Forget означает «не вспомнить, забыть».
explanation.kk: Forget есіне түсірмеу, ұмыту дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: Please give me ___ my pen when you finish.

explanation.en: Give back means return something to its owner.
explanation.ru: Give back означает вернуть что-то владельцу.
explanation.kk: Give back бірдемені иесіне қайтаруды білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: I missed her call, so I will call her ___.

explanation.en: Call back means return a telephone call.
explanation.ru: Call back означает перезвонить.
explanation.kk: Call back қайта қоңырау шалуды білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: The shirt is damaged. I am taking it ___ to the shop.

explanation.en: Take back means return an item.
explanation.ru: Take back означает вернуть вещь.
explanation.kk: Take back затты қайтаруды білдіреді.

questions.question: Read: The café is closed now, but it opens again at two. Let's come back then. What does come back mean here?

explanation.en: Come back means return to the place.
explanation.ru: Come back означает вернуться в то же место.
explanation.kk: Come back сол жерге қайта оралуды білдіреді.

questions.question: Read: I'll lend you £10, but please pay me back on Friday. Who must return the money?

explanation.en: Pay back means return borrowed money to the lender.
explanation.ru: Pay back означает вернуть занятые деньги тому, кто их одолжил.
explanation.kk: Pay back қарызға алынған ақшаны берген адамға қайтаруды білдіреді.

questions.question: A colleague says, “These bags are very heavy.” Which reply uses will to make an immediate offer?

explanation.en: I’ll carry one for you offers help decided at the moment of speaking.
explanation.ru: I’ll carry one for you — предложение помощи, решение принято в момент речи.
explanation.kk: I’ll carry one for you — сөйлеп тұрған сәтте қабылданған көмек ұсынысы.

options.text: Will you be at home tomorrow?
I won’t be in the office next week.
I carry a bag to work every day.

questions.question: Which sentence uses won’t to make a negative prediction?

explanation.en: Won’t is the negative form of will. Here it expresses a prediction.
explanation.ru: Won’t — отрицательная форма will. Здесь она выражает прогноз.
explanation.kk: Won’t — will-дің болымсыз түрі. Мұнда ол болжамды білдіреді.

options.text: I’m sure the shop won’t open before nine.
Opening times are on the door.
I think the shop will open before nine.
The shop didn’t open before nine yesterday.

questions.question: Choose the opposite action. “Please lower the volume.”

explanation.en: Raise means increase, the opposite of lower.
explanation.ru: Raise означает повысить, это противоположность lower.
explanation.kk: Raise көтеру, арттыру дегенді білдіреді, ол lower-дің антонимі.

questions.question: Complete the phrase. “If this coat doesn’t fit, I’ll take it ___ to the shop.”

explanation.en: Take it back to the shop means return it to the place it came from.
explanation.ru: Take it back to the shop означает вернуть это туда, откуда оно взято.
explanation.kk: Take it back to the shop оны алынған жеріне қайтару дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: You leave a message because your friend is unavailable. Which sentence asks them to return your phone call?

explanation.en: Call someone back means return their phone call.
explanation.ru: Call someone back означает перезвонить кому-то.
explanation.kk: Call someone back біреуге қайта қоңырау шалуды білдіреді.

options.text: Could you come back with my book?
Could you write my number down?
Could you turn your phone off this evening?
Could you take this back to the shop?
Could you call me back this evening?

questions.question: Read the conversation. “The forecast says there will be ice tonight.” “Then I’ll take the early bus tomorrow.” Which sentence is a prediction about the weather?

explanation.en: There will be ice predicts a future condition. The second speaker gives their decision.
explanation.ru: There will be ice предсказывает будущее состояние. Второй говорящий сообщает своё решение.
explanation.kk: There will be ice болашақ жағдайды болжайды. Екінші сөйлеуші өз шешімін айтады.

options.text: There is a bus stop near here.
I took the bus this morning.
I’ll take the early bus tomorrow.
